doc.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022

title: Thrown out of a practice room; Don Menza's Fredonia joke
summary: He confirms being told by Dr. Edward Gildane to make way for serious music; Rowe adds Don Menza's line about Dixieland and bebop.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Yeah. I think I read something that made me think of Don Menza, some anecdote about you being in a practice room at a college and someone telling you to get out of there so someone could play some serious music.

That’s true. That’s Dr. Edward Gildane. That’s not a put down because he looked in the room, opened the door and said, “I’m giving you the hairy eyeball. Let somebody serious about music practice in here.” Now having said that, if I went back in time and listened to myself practice I would have thrown myself out, you know? But you’ve got to start somewhat, you know what I mean?
Yeah. Well Don went to SUNY Fredonia at the time they didn’t have jazz. And he made a crack that playing Dixieland was a misdemeanor and playing bebop was a felony.
Oh, that’s great, I love that.
